SCOPE                                 ORDERING INFORMATION - GLOBAL PART NUMBER
This specification describes RC       Global part numbers are identified by the series, size, tolerance, packing
series chip resistors with lead       type, temperature coefficient, taping reel and resistance value.
free terminations made by thick
film process.                         GLOBAL PART NUMBER
                                      RC XXXX X X X XX XXXX L
                                                 (1)     (2) (3) (4)   (5)    (6)    (7)
APPLICATIONS
 All general purpose application     (1) SIZE
                                          0075/0100/0201/0402/0603/0805/1206/1210/1218/2010/2512
FEATURES                              (2) TOLERANCE
 Halogen Free Epoxy                     B = ± 0.1%
 RoHS compliant                         D = ± 0.5%
   Products with lead free              F = ± 1.0%
    terminations meet RoHS               J = ± 5.0% (for jumper ordering, use code of J)
    requirements
                                      (3) PACKAGING TYPE
   Pb-glass contained in
    electrodes, resistors element        R = Paper taping reel
    and glass are exempted by            K = Embossed taping reel
    RoHS                                 S = ESD safe reel (0075/0100 only)
 Reducing environmentally            (4) TEMPERATURE COEFFICIENT OF RESISTANCE
  hazardous wastes
                                              = Based on spec.
 High component and equipment
  reliability                         (5) TAPING REEL & POWER
 Saving of PCB space                    07 = 7 inch dia. Reel & Standard power
 None forbidden-materials used in       10 = 10 inch dia. Reel
  products/production                    13 = 13 inch dia. Reel
 MSL class: MSL 1                       7W = 7 inch dia. Reel & 2 x standard power
                                         7D = 7 inch dia. Reel & 2 x Standard Quantity (0201/0402 only)
                                         7N = 7 inch dia. Reel, ESD safe reel (0075/0100 only)
                                         3W = 13 inch dia. Reel & 2 x standard power
                                      (6) RESISTANCE VALUE
                                         There are 2~4 digits indicated the resistance value.
                                         Letter R/K/M is decimal point
                                         Example:
                                         97R6 = 97.6Ω
                                         9K76 = 9760Ω
                                         1M = 1,000,000Ω
                                      (7) DEFAULT CODE
                                          Letter L is the system default code for ordering only.(Note)

                                      ORDERING EXAMPLE
                                      The ordering code for a RC0402 0.0625W chip resistor value 100K with
                                        5% tolerance, supplied in 7-inch tape reel of 10,000 units per reel is:
                                      RC0402JR-07100KL.
                                      NOTE
                                      1. All our RSMD products meet RoHS compliant and Halogen Free. "LFP" of the internal 2D
                                         reel label mentions "Lead Free Process".
                                      2. On customized label, "LFP" or specific symbol can be printed.

ceramic body. Internal metal electrodes are added
on each end to make the contacts to the thick                                                                            marking layer


film resistive element. The composition of the                                                                           overcoat


resistive element is a noble metal imbedded into a                                                                       primary glass layer

                                                                                                                         resistive layer
glass and covered by a second glass to prevent                                                                           (Jumper chip is a conductor)

environmental influences. The resistor is laser

trimmed to the rated resistance value. The                                                                               inner electrode

coat, finally the two external terminations (matte                                                                       overcoat
